strategy: Add one GitHub-specific workflow_run webhook transport in front of the existing provider-neutral Scheduler. The transport verifies the exact raw body with X-Hub-Signature-256, validates closed delivery/event/repository/run fields, stores sealed raw provider evidence and a replay-safe transport receipt, normalizes only provider identity/correlation/event/conclusion, and invokes the existing Scheduler ingest/wake methods. Expose both a one-request process command and a WSGI HTTP listener behind the root skillctl command. Upgrade the generated concrete Host bootstrap with closed non-authorizing transport configuration; do not add polling, Workflow routing, completion, merge, or product-runtime authority.

unchanged_boundaries: GitHub remains the authority for webhook HMAC validity and provider-native delivery/run fields
EventDrivenCIProviderAdapter remains the only owner of green/red/blocked CI result interpretation
DurableExternalEventScheduler remains the exact wait binding and one-shot delivery owner
StarterHostCommandTransport and StarterHostOrchestrator remain Host transition owners
LangGraph remains Workflow sequencing authority and TaskRun remains lifecycle/completion authority
ChangePermit Write Authority, Human Gate, Quality, release, production, and merge boundaries remain unchanged
customer-agent product source and runtime dependencies remain independent
forbidden_repairs: Do not accept unsigned, malformed, non-workflow_run, non-completed, wrong-repository, oversized, or conflicting replay requests.
Do not normalize by fuzzy repository, run, session, event, or Provider matching.
Do not let the request body choose a Host session; the trusted endpoint/process argument supplies the exact session and the Scheduler revalidates its wait.
Do not poll GitHub, sleep, spawn repair workers, or create another Workflow/TaskRun controller.
Do not interpret CI conclusion outside EventDrivenCIProviderAdapter.
Do not grant write, Human Gate, Quality, completion, release, production, deployment, or merge authority.
Do not expose webhook secrets in bootstrap files, logs, evidence, results, or project command environments.
Do not change services, web, contracts, or standalone customer application dependencies.
required_invariants: HMAC comparison covers the exact received body bytes and uses constant-time comparison
delivery identity, raw body digest, repository, workflow run, head SHA, and normalized event are sealed in durable provider evidence
the same delivery and body is idempotent while the same delivery with different bytes or session fails closed
normalization is fixed to github.actions, run-<id>, ci.completed, and does not decide CI outcome
the exact configured repository and exact trusted session route are required before Scheduler ingest
HTTP serving is event-driven and contains no Provider polling loop
transport delegates only to the existing Scheduler and cannot directly write Host session or TaskRun state
all transport policy fields state authority_effect=false and preserve TaskRun completion authority

focused: a valid signed completed GitHub workflow_run for the configured repository persists sealed raw evidence and delegates exact normalized ingest/wake once
the root one-request CLI and WSGI POST listener use the same transport implementation
initializer and built-in factory attach concrete-host-bootstrap@4 provider transport configuration
counterexamples: missing or invalid signature, delivery ID, event type, action, run status, repository, run ID, head SHA, body encoding, content type, or size fails closed
same delivery with changed bytes or changed session is rejected and concurrent replay cannot submit twice
Scheduler rejection remains rejection and cannot be converted to success by the listener
regression: Scheduler, Provider adapter, Host bootstrap, initializer, Host runtime/transport, schemas, and complete skill-unit suites remain green
negative_path: listener contains no Provider polling or merge/completion/write transition
webhook secret never appears in durable artifacts, output, bootstrap, or project command environment
product source and dependencies remain unchanged

risks: The built-in HTTP server is intended behind an HTTPS reverse proxy; TLS termination and public network policy remain deployment responsibilities.
GitHub may retry a delivery after a process crash; sealed evidence plus Scheduler idempotency must make that retry safe.
A valid GitHub event sent to the wrong session route is authenticated but still rejected by exact Scheduler wait correlation.
Other Providers require separate listener adapters with their own authentication and payload contracts.
rollback_plan: Remove the GitHub webhook transport module, root command, @4 provider_webhook declaration, tests, and docs; restore concrete-host-bootstrap@3 and retain the already merged trusted normalized scheduler ingest/wake boundary from PR #2100.
